title: Luscious Gooey Moroccan Pecan Nuts Tagine
description: A rich and comforting Moroccan dish featuring gooey pecan nuts and confit-tomato, served in a banana leaf. Perfect for a sick-day meal.
instructions: Cut the banana leaves into 6-inch squares, and rinse them under cold water.
In a large skillet, melt 1 tablespoon of butter over medium heat.
Add the pecan nuts and cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant and lightly toasted, about 5 minutes.
Add the confit tomatoes, honey, cinnamon, ginger, and salt to the skillet. Stir to combine.
Cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring frequently, until the mixture is heated through.
Transfer the mixture to the center of each banana leaf square, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Dot the top of each serving with the remaining 1 tablespoon of butter.
Fold the banana leaves over the filling to form a triangle or square, and secure with a toothpick if needed.
Repeat with the remaining banana leaf squares and filling.
Place the tagines on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, and bake for 10-12 minutes, or until the banana leaves are tender and the filling is hot and bubbly.
Serve the tagines hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley.
